name: qwen-image-2.0
description: Alibaba's flagship large language model representing the pinnacle of the Qwen series. It achieves top-tier performance across various benchmarks including MMLU, HumanEval, and C-Eval. The model excels at complex reasoning, long-context understanding, and instruction following. With its massive scale and sophisticated training methodology, Qwen3-Max competes with the world's leading foundation models while maintaining efficiency through architectural optimizations.
zhDescription: 阿里云通义千问图像2.0版本，能够从文本提示生成高质量图像。支持多种艺术风格和详细场景生成，适用于创意应用。
